# in temporal frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inTemporalFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an instant to the temporal frame in which its value is expressed.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) -> [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md) from [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) to [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) interpreting a [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md)'s value — the frame edge for points that satisfies the instant's frame-relativity requirement (P11).

### Avoid when

- Avoid on an interval (use [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md), the parallel edge for spans) and avoid leaving a crisp instant frameless — a value asserted without its frame is ill-formed (P11).

### How to use

- Point the instant at one [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md); it specializes [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) so generic frame consumers read instants and intervals uniformly.

### Examples

- ex:birthInstant [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md) [`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md).
